findings.title: Model-directed instruction hidden in SKILL.md:body
findings.detail: Matched 2 injection indicator(s): covert-action directive, sensitive-data transfer directive. Description fields and markdown bodies reach the model as instructions but are frequently not rendered in the UI the user approves from. Heuristic: this reads intent from text.

findings.title: Dynamic analysis not possible for this target
findings.detail: Dataset requested declaration-only analysis. airlock found no executable artefact, so there is no behaviour to observe and only the declaration was checked. This is the weakest form of assurance and is the entire reason pattern-only scanners get bypassed -- do not read this result as a clean bill of health.
